relationship_to_previous_pr: stacked_on_645_baseline_and_negative_66_OOD; old data are NOT used for new holdout
source_manifest: SHA256 original-CNF hashes must be generated and committed before any neural evaluation, and lockfile exact Git blob must be pinned in runner
constrained_parent_rule: unsupported width or uncertain proof => ABSTAIN_NOT_PROOF
strict_success_definition: first source-entailed fully sign-mask XOR with independent original-source resolution DAG replay and coefficient-rank increment >0 relative to UP plus full-mask XOR; only existence of a hit, NOT complete inventory of all XOR/rank
early_exit: COLD may stop after first EXACT_PROOF_VERIFIED positive; if none, exhaust original budget and return ABSTAIN_NO_HIT; never treat incomplete search as proof of no more XOR
whole_training_and_eval_cost: 90 exact training probe receipts per seed for neural and trained teacher
real training and inference CPU time
holdout exact root checks in each policy
separate full-audit oracle cost excluded from virtual deployment and reported as research measurement overhead
calibration: Brier/ECE scores on holdout for diagnostic only; calibration temperature chosen from train data only
comparability: same source SHA, same exact resolver and replay, same training labels for JGPT/teacher, identical frozen OOD; no cherry-pick or omissions
risk_policy: COLD after verified hit can stop only for existence-of-one-XOR objective; full coverage or all-rank requests MUST use exhaustive COLD
no_known_future_labels_or_generation_hin: features from original CNF only; no family label or numeric pivot ID
go_gate: no production weights unless strictly lower total amortized cost than equal-trained teacher and static over each independent OOD seed with same 100% math hit coverage, repeatable Q1024 weights across independent CI jobs, external source verification still separate
